familyFit.access: Tapered upper cabin made the third restraint width critical in the test.
familyFit.ventilation: Base has rear console vents and manual air conditioning; Elite dual-zone climate equipment differs.

cons: Three full-size seats did not fit in the published test.

vehicles.headline: Eight seats, five restraint positions and useful occupied-row boot space
vehicles.summary: The most flexible seating layout of these three combustion options. Its diesel suits regular longer drives; repeated short school runs can complicate DPF operation. S uses manual sliding doors.

boot.basis: Manufacturer MY22 brochure labels this VDA with third row folded. It also lists 2,461 L SAE; standards and loading limits differ, so compare with care.

bootAllRows.basis: VDA with all three rows upright. The brochure separately quotes 1,139 L SAE; do not mix standards.

length.basis: Original KA4 Australian body; excludes facelift.

towing.basis: Braked; maximum published towball 200 kg. Check payload and towbar rating.

vehicles.warranty: 7 years / unlimited km private use; any rental/commercial use can impose 150,000-km limit.
vehicles.servicing: 12 months / 15,000 km; published seven-visit diesel schedule varies by model year.

safety.applicability: KA4 diesel covered, rating expires December 2027. Cars built before February 2024 lack the later front-centre airbag; all-row curtain airbags are standard.

familyFit.summary: BabyDrive fitted five restraints in related SLi trim, including three across row two. S retains the published five anchor positions; your fit check remains pending.
familyFit.row2: Three individual sliding seats, each with ISOFIX and top tether.
familyFit.row3: ISOFIX and top tether at both outboard positions; centre has neither and is not a child-restraint position.
familyFit.testedSeats: Five restraints in BabyDrive SLi test; exact product models were not identified in the article. Three across row two plus two outboard in row three.
familyFit.buckleAccess: No exact S three-booster trial. ANCAP could not fit one rear-facing convertible using outer ISOFIX in rows two/three; one forward-facing model needed care at row-three ISOFIX. Check each seat and buckle.
familyFit.access: Removing row-two centre creates a walkway. In the related test an outer row-two seat could slide with an ISOFIX-installed restraint; verify instructions before moving it occupied. S has manual sliding doors.
familyFit.ventilation: Roof vents reach rows two and three. S has manual air conditioning; higher grades add climate controls.

pros: Five ISOFIX/top-tether positions over two rear rows.
627 L VDA luggage capacity with all rows occupied.
Sliding doors and removable row-two centre seat.
cons: Diesel DPF needs suitable driving; short-trip-only use deserves care.
Base S lacks powered doors and higher-trim climate features.
inspection: Fit three restraints and practise access to row three with luggage loaded.
Check DPF warnings, diagnostic fault history and the previous owner’s driving pattern; seek a diesel inspection.
Verify any rental/commercial history and remaining warranty kilometre limits.
Check sliding-door latches, recall status, air conditioning for every row and service invoices.

risks.title: Seat-belt warning recall
risks.detail: REC-005699: selected 2022–23 NQ5 VINs require instrument-cluster software correction.
risks.priceBasis: Official applicable recall remedy is free; not an annual paid-repair cost.

risks.title: Unscheduled engine, cooling or transmission work
risks.detail: Check cold operation, oil level/history, leaks and all automatic shifts. The 2.0 MPi six-speed auto is distinct from the 1.6 turbo DCT; do not transfer the wrong powertrain’s faults.
risks.priceBasis: No current Australian exact-VIN installed quote verified; diagnosis and written quote required.
risks.warranty: Confirm first delivery, maintenance and commercial-use exclusions before paying.

fuelEstimate.basis: Analyst family-driving estimate in L/100 km: 9.5 midpoint, 8.1–12 scenario range. Published ADR combined 8.1 and urban 11.0 anchor it; not a measured fleet average.

ownership.serviceInterval: 12 months / 15,000 km for 2.0 MPi; VIN-specific service quote required.
ownership.serviceBasis: A$450/year long-ownership planning allowance, A$300–750 sensitivity bounds. The exact 2021 base 2.0 test records the original first-five-service price of A$319 each at 12 months/15,000 km. That historical A$1,595 total does not quote a used car’s remaining major services or current VIN prices; A$450 includes a later-life buffer.
warrantyCautions: Check original delivery date, maintenance records and the vehicle’s own warranty contract.

The standard warranty is five years/unlimited km. The later two-year dealer-service-conditional extension requires first registration from 1 June 2025; eligibility depends on that date and service history, not simply model year.
Wear, accident damage and optional upgrades are separate from manufacturing defects.

risks.title: FCA and instrument-display software recalls
risks.detail: Check VINs for REC-006615 and REC-006717 (notices describe 2023–26 Tucson): free software remedies for unexpected braking and missing display information. Confirm actual applicability; equipment and dates vary.
risks.priceBasis: Free official VIN-applicable software remedies; do not annualise these as repair bills.
risks.warranty: Recall rectification is separate from remaining basic warranty.

risks.title: Older petrol-car repairs outside basic cover
risks.detail: Inspect oil use/leaks, cooling, air conditioning, suspension and the six-speed automatic. No verified Australian annual failure-cost dataset or exact installed major-component quote was found.
risks.priceBasis: Unpriced evidence gap; get diagnosis and a written local quote.
risks.warranty: 2021–24 original five-year warranty terms govern; later offers do not restart it.

fuelEstimate.basis: L/100 km family-driving planning scenario: 9.5 point, 8.1–12 sensitivity bounds. ADR combined 8.1 / urban 11.0 anchor the range; an exact base 2.0 CarsGuide test averaged 8.8 over a suburban week. The 9.5 point and bounds are analyst assumptions, not a measured fleet average.

ownership.serviceInterval: 12 months / 15,000 km; published seven-visit diesel schedule varies by model year.
ownership.serviceBasis: A$600/year long-ownership planning budget. Current Kia table: 2021/22 diesel seven visits A$3,767 (~A$538/year); 2023 A$3,816 (~A$545/year). Used cars may already have passed expensive visits or the 105,000-km capped schedule; reconfirm VIN pricing.

risks.title: DPF replacement — Australian Kia workshop proxy
risks.detail: A Sydney DPF workshop that services Carnival CRDi lists Kia replacement at A$3,000–7,000 fitted and cleaning from aboutA$500. These are different interventions: diagnosis decides whether cleaning or replacement is appropriate. This is broad Kia guidance, not an exact KA4 quote or a failure rate. Repeated short/slow trips can impede soot regeneration.
risks.priceBasis: AUD fitted replacement guidance from an Australian Kia DPF workshop; exact KA4 part, labour, GST inclusions and local diagnosis require a written quote. Cleaning-from pricing is not a replacement quote.
risks.warranty: A diagnosed manufacturing defect may be covered; soot loading, use pattern and maintenance exclusions need assessment. Follow the specific Australian handbook.

risks.title: VIN-specific early KA4 recalls
risks.detail: REC-005019 concerns selected 2021 right sliding-door latches; REC-001615 selected 2021 fuel pipes. REC-005685 concerns POWER sliding doors; base S manual doors must not be assumed affected by that equipment-specific campaign.
risks.priceBasis: Applicable official recall inspection/repair is free. No default paid replacement allowance.
risks.warranty: Check exact VIN and equipment with Kia; independent of ordinary warranty expiry.
